overall_diagnosis: The defect is localized to maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md. Multiple signals indicate the legacy CI repair workflow guidance is incomplete and partially corrupted, especially around Maven/JDK toolchain selection, reproducible failure commands, and handling nested Maven Invoker builds. The current instructions do not clearly standardize how to reproduce CI failures, verify the intended Java/Maven environment, or debug nested integration-test POMs and dependency drift, which can cause incorrect local reproduction and failed build repairs.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill contains incomplete and inconsistent guidance for reproducing Maven CI failures in legacy multi-module and invoker-driven builds. Problems include corrupted/incomplete text (missing numbered step and unfinished sentence fragment), insufficient instructions for selecting and validating the correct JDK/Maven toolchain, ambiguous Maven command conventions, and unclear workflows for reproducing nested invoker integration-test failures and inspecting dependency resolution inside nested projects.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Revise maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md to provide a complete and internally consistent CI repair workflow. Fix broken numbering and remove unfinished text fragments. Add an explicit subsection on toolchain selection and validation covering JAVA_HOME, toolchains.xml, Maven Wrapper/.mvn usage, maven-enforcer/compiler release settings, and confirming required Maven/JDK versions. Add canonical reproduction command templates and conventions for CI-style debugging, including guidance for clean vs incremental builds, targeted module builds (-pl/-am), stacktrace/debug flags (-e, -X, -DtrimStackTrace=false), and when to skip or execute tests and invoker ITs. Clarify how to reproduce and debug nested invoker builds, inspect build.log files, preserve CI profiles/properties, and use dependency:tree/help:effective-pom within the nested project to confirm selected dependency versions such as Guava and guava-testlib.
